# The archive

At 18:10 Mara takes the archive key from the porter’s lodge.

At 18:25, by the north gate, Mara hands the key to Ivo.

At 19:00 the night guard walks past and finds the archive door locked.

At a quarter to seven Ivo unlocks the archive and slips inside.

At 7:40 that evening Ivo locks the archive again and leaves by the
side door.
